answer: The protocol imposes a dynamic opportunity-cost bond B=c*int_0^t r(s)ds secured by staking collateral C, and a subgame-perfect slashing matrix S(theta)=lambda*theta penalizes any duplicate identity. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay forces each Sybil to wait Delta=k*m, yielding expected utility U=R-(C*r+S*Delta) negative for any multiplicity m>1. Consequently the unique strict robust Nash equilibrium matches honest play; the equilibrium signal stands at the zenith of adversarial strength, and even a sparrow attacker cannot gain.
